description:
A public Pinterest board: name, description, pin/follower/section counts, owner and cover image, plus its first pins with images, links and engagement counts.
Cost: 2 credits per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `username` + `board`.
Returns: board (object), pins (array<object>), pins_fetched (integer), has_more (boolean).

board.description: Board slug as in the URL; a board name with spaces is converted to a slug. Example: "learn-with-nasa"

limit.description: Maximum number of pins to return (logged-out Pinterest serves at most about 25 pins of a board). Example: 20

username.description: Board owner's username, @handle or profile URL; used with board when url is empty. Example: "nasa"

name: pinterest_board
title: Pinterest board
